summary: Feature implemented but not executed: I made no test runs, per instructions, so all verification was by reading and a shell lint scan (newline endings, trailing whitespace, comma spacing). Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver); changed the nifti_writer default dtype to np.float32; added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; rewrote the segmentation and classification handlers as thin adapters over the savers (output_dir, filename, index parameters as specified); rewrote TensorBoardImageHandler to delegate to the plot function. Renamed output_path to output_dir in two example scripts and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Added tests test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and updated test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Nothing committed. Open risk: the ignite 0.3.0 attach path for the classification completion hook and all new tests are unverified until someone runs flake8 and the test suite.
